title: US extends AI chip export controls to remote access
summary: The U.S. Commerce Department issued an interim final rule on Nov. 16 extending export controls on advanced AI chips and servers to remote access, aiming to prevent circumvention through third-country data centers. The rule also requires licenses for re-exporting AI chips to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brazil, according to Reuters and The Verge. The available account does not specify the rule&\#x27;s effective date, technical thresholds or full licensing terms.
